headline: Iran Warns of Strait Closure Amid Escalating Middle East Tensions
subheadline: Iran stated it would target all U.S. oil and economic interests if new sanctions are imposed, threatening to shut the Strait of Hormuz.
lede: Iran warned it would close the Strait of Hormuz and target all U.S. oil and economic interests if new sanctions are imposed. Israeli forces killed Hamas tunnel-restoration commander Sharif al-Hasanat in Deir al-Balah, Gaza, while discovering four explosive drones near the Gaza border with no immediate public threat. Russian ballistic missiles struck Kryvyi Rih, killing 16 and injuring 130, as France announced missile deliveries to Ukraine to counter Russian attacks.

sections.title: Russian Strikes Hammer Ukrainian Cities and Infrastructure
sections.body: Russian ballistic missile strikes hit Kryvyi Rih, killing 16 and injuring 130. Twenty Shahed drones struck Odesa, Chernomorsk, and Zatoka. French missile deliveries to Ukraine were announced to counter Russian attacks. Russian strikes also targeted Kherson region infrastructure, while reactive drones attacked Poltava and Sumy regions.

sections.title: Israel Targets Hamas Amid Regional Tensions
sections.body: Israeli forces killed Hamas commander Sharif al-Hasanat in Deir al-Balah, Gaza, for his role in tunnel restoration and terror attacks. Hezbollah reported cross-border artillery fire targeting Israeli positions in southern Lebanon, including near the border village of Beit Jinn. An Israeli drone strike hit a car in Beit Jinn, Syria, about ten kilometers from the Israeli border, injuring one person. The UAE completed construction of large metal fuel storage cages in Abu Dhabi to protect against Iranian drone attacks.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Iran's explicit threat to close the Strait of Hormuz and target U.S. interests signals heightened escalation risk, while Israeli airstrikes in Gaza and Syria demonstrate continued operational pressure on Hamas and Hezbollah. Russian missile and drone barrages across Ukrainian cities indicate an effort to degrade infrastructure, countered by France's announced missile deliveries to Ukraine. The UAE's construction of defensive fuel storage cages reflects growing concern over Iranian drone capabilities, suggesting a regional shift toward protective measures.
